mapper.sql: flt08_buy_lockup_id AS buy_lockup_id, flt08_company_id AS company_id, flt08_item_cd AS item_code, com50_item_nm AS item_name, TO_CHAR(flt08_start_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS start_date, TO_CHAR(flt08_close_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS close_date, flt08_lockup_type AS lockup_type, f_cdnm('BuyLockupType', flt08_lockup_type, flt08_company_id, f_today()) AS lockup_type_name
mapper.select: SELECT FROM flt08_buy_lockup INNER JOIN com50_item ON com50_item_cd = flt08_item_cd WHERE flt08_company_id = #{companyId} AND flt08_lockup_type LIKE #{lockupType} AND UPPER(CONCAT(flt08_item_cd, com50_item_nm)) LIKE UPPER(#{searchText}) ORDER BY flt08_item_cd, flt08_start_date
SELECT FROM flt08_buy_lockup INNER JOIN com50_item ON com50_item_cd = flt08_item_cd WHERE flt08_buy_lockup_id = #{buyLockupId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO flt08_buy_lockup (flt08_buy_lockup_id, flt08_company_id, flt08_item_cd, flt08_start_date, flt08_close_date, flt08_lockup_type) VALUES (#{buyLockupId}, #{companyId}, #{req.itemCode}, CAST(#{req.startDate} AS date), CAST(#{req.closeDate,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS date), #{req.lockupType})
